Specification: This module specifies a fast mutual exclusion algorithm for N processes, originally written in PlusCal and translated into TLA+. Each process repeatedly competes to enter a critical section using shared variables x, y, a per-process Boolean flag array b, and a per-process waiting set S; the control flow includes retries and goto-style restarts. The specification defines initialization, per-label actions, a next-state relation with weak fairness on Next, a mutual exclusion invariant asserting that no two distinct processes are simultaneously in the critical section, and a liveness property stating that infinitely often some process is in the critical section.

IF x # self THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l8"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"]
IF S[self] # {} THEN /\ \E j \in S[self]: /\ ~b[j] /\ S' = [S EXCEPT ![self] = S[self] \ {j}] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l9"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l10"] /\ S' = S
IF y # self THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l11"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"]
